actions.action: Preserve arrival-based priority across every reroute
actions.mechanism: Queue placement follows immutable arrival order, not the latest team transfer or tag correction.
actions.implementation: Store write-once arrival timestamps and stable admission sequence numbers. Order eligible cases within explicit urgency classes by these fields; record transfers separately.
actions.check: Simulate simultaneous arrivals and repeated wrong-tag transfers. Verify deterministic ordering and unchanged priority keys after every transfer.
actions.risk: Urgency classes can starve ordinary cases; monitor oldest waits.

actions.action: Gate assignment against live qualifications and capacity
actions.mechanism: Atomic dispatch checks prevent routing errors and shift changes from producing ineligible or excess assignments.
actions.implementation: Require language, product expertise, and urgent qualification when applicable. Validate roster version and reserve capacity transactionally; retry conflicts. Derive urgency only from explicit issue criteria.
actions.check: Race dispatches across a shift change. With neither trained urgent worker available, verify urgent cases remain unassigned and trigger an alert.
actions.risk: Stale roster data can block otherwise valid assignments.

actions.action: Expose separate skill and information blockers
actions.mechanism: Independent blocker flags explain stalled cases without replacing their original waiting priority.
actions.implementation: Display missing skills, required information, and next review owner. Allow both blockers simultaneously. Clear information blockers on receipt and restore dispatch eligibility using original arrival order.
actions.check: Test skill-only, information-only, and combined blockers. Verify clearing one leaves the other visible and never resets arrival time.
actions.risk: Unnecessary information requests could become a way to sideline cases.

actions.action: Run bounded reviews of suspected wrong tags
actions.mechanism: Small, monitored correction batches address routing errors without flooding newly eligible workers or rewriting case history.
actions.implementation: Pilot five oldest flagged cases only when rostered review capacity exists. Confirm tags from case evidence; stop on disputed corrections. Otherwise retain cases for individual review.
actions.check: Seed known tagging errors; verify corrections, unchanged timestamps, and continued qualification checks. Remove review capacity and confirm batch work stops.
actions.risk: Incorrect corrections can cause further bouncing; keep an audit trail.
